summary: Iteration 2 frontend-only e2e verification. Validated 14 flows from the review request, including all regressions (5/5) and all new Modo INE features (4/4). All passed against the public preview URL. Specifically: (1) NO MORE 'useEffect is not defined' crash on placement — image placed via double-click from sidebar and screen stayed alive with 0 console errors. (2) OS-level drag→drop of 2 PNGs onto canvas-workspace (DataTransfer with File objects, dispatched via DragEvent) correctly produces 2 placements AND 2 thumbnails in left sidebar (images[] is updated). (3) Modo INE toggle activates header pill (blue), ine-mode-indicator in the top bar, and ine-mode-panel in RightSidebar with the layout-ine button; deactivating removes all three. (4) layout-ine with 2 images creates exactly 2 placements with wPct=39.65 (≈85.6/216), hPct=19.33 (≈54/279), xPct=30.18 (centered), top yPct=23.34 and bottom yPct=57.34 — matching the spec. (5) layout-ine with 1 image duplicates into 2 placements with same imageId. (6) process-as-ine-button only renders when a placement is selected; clicking it changed image src in ~1s (8610→8190 bytes) and showed Sonner toast 'Filtro aplicado y recortada por proporción INE' — fallback by-ratio crop worked correctly because docs.opencv.org CDN was blocked in headless (cv_loaded=false), exactly the documented expected behavior. (7) All legacy layouts (Auto-fit, Media hoja, 2×2, 3×3, 4×4) still work. (8) Guillotine toggle renders purple dashed border (computed border-color rgb(139,92,246), borderStyle dashed) AND the 'g' keyboard shortcut toggles the switch (checked↔unchecked). (9) Delete shortcut removes selected placement; Esc deselects (selection-editor unmounts). (10) Paper size change (Carta→Oficio) and orientation change (Vertical→Horizontal) update the indicator and canvas proportions correctly. (11) clear-canvas-button wipes placements but keeps thumbnails; clear-all-button wipes both. Zero console errors across the full run.
critical_code_review_comments: PrinterContext.dropImagesAt line 212: hPct formula has a subtle bug — it uses (wPct * (widthMm/heightMm)) / aspect, but to convert an aspect ratio to %-of-different-axis you should divide by aspect (image w/h) and multiply by sheet w/h. The math here happens to produce reasonable values only because the clamp to [8,70] hides edge cases, but for non-square images on landscape sheets the formula can over- or under-shoot. Recommend: hPct = (wPct * widthMm) / (aspect * heightMm) for proper aspect preservation.
Canvas.jsx onDrop line 65: clamp range Math.min(70, xPct - 15) still hardcoded based on wPct/hPct=30 defaults — same comment as iteration 1, still not addressed.

ineProcessor loads OpenCV from https://docs.opencv.org/4.10.0/opencv.js — fallback works (verified), but consider caching the CDN load result or self-hosting the wasm to avoid a 2-5s first-call latency in production and to remove an external runtime dependency.

PrinterContext.applyIneLayout line 244: when duplicating a single image, both placements share the same imageId — applying Procesar como INE to one will modify both (since src is replaced on the shared Image). This is likely intentional ('frente y reverso son la misma foto, duplicada') but worth documenting; if user wants different processing per side they cannot.

RightSidebar process-as-ine-button: success toast text differentiates 'detectada' vs 'recortada por proporción', but on detection failure inside processIneImage the function still returns a result (no throw) — so the catch branch is unreachable in practice. Minor UX nit.
seed_data_creation: Dummy PNGs generated at runtime via canvas.toBlob (200×200, 300×200, 600×400 sizes) and injected through (a) file-input.files via DataTransfer and (b) DragEvent with dataTransfer on canvas-workspace. No persistence.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is 100% frontend (Vite+React 18+Tailwind, no backend). All data-testids from the spec exist and work: app-header, canvas-workspace, file-input, image-thumbnail-item, ine-mode-toggle, ine-mode-indicator, ine-mode-panel, layout-ine, process-as-ine-button, selection-editor, guillotine-mode-toggle, clear-all-button, clear-canvas-button, paper-size-select, paper-size-{id}, orientation-select, layout-{auto|half|2x2|3x3|4x4}, canvas-placement. To simulate OS drop on canvas, dispatch DragEvent('drop', {dataTransfer}) where dataTransfer is a DataTransfer with File objects added via items.add(). docs.opencv.org CDN is blocked in this headless preview — processImageAsIne's by-ratio fallback always works and changes the image src within ~1s, with toast 'Filtro aplicado y recortada por proporción INE'. To verify the purple guillotine border use getComputedStyle and check borderColor for rgb(139, 92, 246) (NOT the literal '#8b5cf6' since React serializes). The 'Limpiar todo' uses window.confirm — register a dialog handler before clicking. Console was clean (0 errors) across all flows.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. The earlier-reported 'useEffect is not defined' crash from iteration 1.5 is fully resolved (verified by uploading and double-clicking an image — page stayed alive with zero console errors). All Modo INE additions integrate cleanly without breaking any pre-existing flow.
